name: Fish Audio S2.1 Pro
access: Fish Audio API: POST /v1/tts and a WebSocket live endpoint, `model` header s2.1-pro; free development tier `s2.1-pro-free`
Fish Audio web app and Voice Agents platform

voice.input_audio: none: the model takes text, with inline [bracket] cues, speaker tags and phoneme tags
voice.output_audio: wav, pcm, mp3 (64, 128 or 192 kbps) and opus (automatic, or 24 to 64 kbps); the sample rate is the format default (44.1 kHz for most, 48 kHz for opus) unless set [fish-openapi]
voice.voices: custom cloning from reference audio (zero-shot, or a saved voice model), a Voice Library, and candidate voices from a natural-language prompt through the voice design endpoint [fish-openapi] [fish-voice-design]
languages: 83 languages with automatic language detection, including English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Spanish, Arabic, French, German, Portuguese and Russian [fish-models] [fish-blog-s21]
voice.latency: About 90 ms time to first audio on the standard API and about 70 ms for a single request, per the maker's launch post; the models page gives production TTFA and DPA guarantees for the paid model [fish-blog-s21] [fish-models]
voice.session_limit: The text limit per request was not found in the pages read; the server processes text in chunks of 100 to 300 characters (default 300), and the WebSocket takes text events between a start and a stop event [fish-openapi]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Per UTF-8 byte of input text: US$15.00 per 1M bytes for `s2.1-pro` and for `s2-pro`; Fish Audio says 1M bytes is about 180,000 English words or about 12 hours of speech [fish-pricing]. `s2.1-pro-free` runs the same model as `s2.1-pro` at US$0 under a fair-use policy, with no latency guarantee, possible data retention for model improvement, and an end date of 2026-11-30 in the launch post [fish-models] [fish-blog-s21]. Voice design costs US$0.01 per successful request [fish-pricing]. Artificial Analysis lists US$15 per 1M characters [aa-tts-board]

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Speech Arena Elo (text-to-speech leaderboard)
benchmarks.setting: blind pairwise listener votes; the quality Elo in the leaderboard data of the page, read on 2026-10-04

unknown: context_window: not applicable to a synthesis model
max_output: not published; the text limit per request was not found in the pages read
pricing_usd_per_mtok: the unit differs (US$ per 1M UTF-8 bytes), see notes
system_card: Fish Audio publishes no system card for the hosted model in the pages read; the S2 Pro model card is on Hugging Face [fish-hf-s2]
voice.turn_detection: not applicable; a synthesis model does not listen
voice.interruption: not applicable; a synthesis model does not take turns
weights: the maker says S2.1 Pro is proprietary and S2 Pro was released with open weights; no S2.1 weights are published in the pages read [fish-blog-s21]
voice.latency: the two figures come from the maker; the launch post gives no sample size or path
